verses.text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.
A man with a skin disease came and knelt in front of him. He said, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" Straight away the man was healed of his skin disease.
Then Jesus said to him, "Make sure you do not tell anyone. But go and show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded. This will show them that you are healed."
When Jesus went into Capernaum, a Roman army officer came to him and asked him for help.
"Lord," he said, "my servant is lying at home and cannot move. He is suffering terribly."
Jesus said to him, "I will come and heal him."
The officer replied, "Lord, I am not good enough for you to come into my house. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
I am a man who is under authority myself, and I have soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes. I tell that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I tell my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."
When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. He said to the people following him, "I tell you for certain, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
I tell you that many people will come from the east and the west. They will sit down to eat with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
But those who should have belonged to the kingdom will be thrown outside into the darkness. There people will cry and grind their teeth."
Then Jesus said to the officer, "Go! What you believed will happen." And his servant was healed at that very moment.
When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw Peter's mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and began to serve him.
When evening came, many people who had demons were brought to Jesus. He drove out the spirits with a word and healed everyone who was ill.
This made come true what the prophet Isaiah had said: "He took away our weaknesses and carried our diseases."
When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he told his followers to cross to the other side of the lake.
Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."
Jesus replied, "Foxes have holes and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to rest his head."
Another follower said to him, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."
But Jesus told him, "Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead."
Then Jesus got into a boat, and his followers went with him.
Suddenly a terrible storm came up on the lake, so that the waves were covering the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.
The followers went and woke him up. They said, "Lord, save us! We are going to drown!"
He replied, "Why are you so afraid? Your faith is so small!" Then he got up and ordered the winds and the waves to stop, and everything became completely calm.
The men were amazed. They asked, "What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!"
When Jesus arrived on the other side, in the country of the Gergesenes, two men who had demons met him. They came out of the tombs, and they were so violent that no one could use that road.
They shouted, "What do you want with us, Son of God? Have you come here to punish us before the right time?"
Some distance away a large herd of pigs was feeding.
The demons begged Jesus, "If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs."
He said to them, "Go!" So they came out and went into the pigs. Then the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned in the water.
The men looking after the pigs ran off into the town. They told everything that had happened, including what had happened to the men who had demons.
Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their area.
